_comment: Quick-chat allowlist (docs/roadmap/WAVE-5-MULTIPLAYER-DESIGN.md section 4.2). Ids only, never text: the relay accepts a chat frame only if phraseId is one of these integers. Phrases 1-12 are text phrases, 101-106 are emotes (smile, clap, wow, think, heart, wave). The ids are stable forever; the Android client resolves them to strings in the receiver's locale. Do not renumber.
